1 of 5 · First half

How it started.

The Lakers led 31–22 after one quarter. At the half, the Lakers led 68–57.

Scroll to keep going
2 of 5 · The difference

Luka: 32 points, 10 assists, 5 steals

11 of 22 from the floor, 7 of 7 at the line, 8 rebounds.

3 of 5 · How it turned

Won the first quarter 31–22

From the opening tip, the Lakers won the first quarter 31–22 to lead 31–22. Luka and Mamukelashvili combined for 55 of the 124.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it in the paint and with 16 steals

Points in the paint 52–42; steals 16–12. L.A. had 16 steals, five by Luka.

5 of 5 · Final

Lakers 124, Hawks 114.

From the Hawks’ side: Lost the first quarter 22–31, the stretch that decided it.

What it meant: Lakers 11–2, 1st in the West, 87% top-6 odds. Hawks 7–5, 4th in the East, 62%.

2 · The play of the game

Luka to the rim.

Luka Dončić's driving finger-roll layup with 2:27 left that made it 117–111 after Atlanta had cut the lead to four.
